shoulders.notes: GAP: No dedicated shoulder width or shoulder slope morph targets in core pack.

torso_chest.notes: Circumference fitting only via girth morph targets; no independent pectoral/chest shape controls.

abdomen.notes: GAP: No stomach/belly protrusion or abdomen shape controls outside global weight/waist.

upper_arm.notes: GAP: No arm thickness, bicep girth, or sleeve fit adjustment morphs.

lower_arm.notes: GAP: No forearm or wrist morphs.

thighs.notes: GAP: No thigh girth or leg shape targets in core pack.

calves.notes: GAP: No calf circumference or lower leg targets in core pack.

morphology_and_mesh.age_coverage: Young to Old adult corners (no pediatric/child morphology in core pack)
morphology_and_mesh.garment_fit_suitability: Suitable for basic waist/bust silhouette, but unsuitable for detailed shoulder/arm/thigh regional fit zones due to lack of localized blendshapes.

fit_to_measurements_analysis.algorithm: Convex optimization / bounded gradient descent over 8 girth target weights
fit_to_measurements_analysis.nature_of_residuals: Internal self-consistency only (optimizing weights to minimize delta against synthetic vertex slices). Does NOT validate accuracy against real human tape measurements.
